messages:
Aisha (Partnerships): flagged a slightly messy intake today — two SI reps and a field AE grabbed the same lead. need a quick adjudication playbook.
Marco (Sales): saw that. lead was from marketplace inquiry, company size ~midmarket. AE already logged discovery.
Riley (SI Ops): from ops side we want to avoid duplicate outreach. propose: marketplace leads route to cohort queue, SI reps can claim within 24h, otherwise default to AE.
Sam (Solutions): +1 but we need rules for co-sell credit and contact ownership — if SI deeply involved, they should be primary for 30 days.
Aisha (Partnerships): suggestion: adjudication ruleset v1 below. open to edits.
Aisha (Partnerships): ```
1) Source=Marketplace -> create intake ticket in Partner Intake queue
2) If SI indicated in form -> assign to SI-assigned queue and ping SI Slack channel
3) If AE has existing opportunity in last 90d -> mark as AE-owned unless SI provides formal co-sell request
4) Tie-break: bigger contract value -> owner; if equal -> shared, create joint playbook
5) SI must attach SOW or kickoff note within 7 days or ownership reverts
```
Marco (Sales): that looks fair. question: who enforces the 7d SOW rule?
Riley (SI Ops): DeployBot can auto-remind at day 4 + day 6 and then move lead to AE if no doc. I can add the automation.
DeployBot: automation scheduled: partner-intake-reminder -> day4/day6 -> escalate -> reassign on day8 if no SOW.
Jin (Legal): tiny ask — when ownership switches we need audit trail for revenue share. ensure CRM comment includes "OwnershipChange: reason" with timestamp.
Sam (Solutions): noted. also propose a quick account mapping matrix for overlapping territories: attach the mapping snippet I used in the pilot.
Sam (Solutions): ```csv
account_pattern,owner_hint,priority
*.edu,FieldAE,2
*.enterprise,SI,1
region:EMEA,AE,2
partner:hardware-vendor,SI,1
```
Aisha (Partnerships): love the matrix. next steps: Riley to add DeployBot rules, Marco to confirm sales compensation trigger, Jin to add audit tag, Sam to push mapping to shared repo. I'll run a 15-min sync tomorrow to sign off. :thumbsup:
Marco (Sales): will review comp trigger and ping payroll.
Riley (SI Ops): creating automation now, will post PR link when ready.
Jin (Legal): I'll add the CRM template.
DeployBot: created task 8923 for automation PR.
Aisha (Partnerships): thanks team — if anyone hits edge cases after rollout, drop them in #partnerships-incidents and we'll triage. :eyes:
